name: Sofia Castro
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, through a fascination with aerodynamics and fluid dynamics during her engineering studies in Lisbon. Rather than pursue a typical mechanical engineering path, she sought out opportunities to apply her knowledge in wind tunnel testing, initially working on aerospace projects before transitioning to motorsport. Her meticulous approach and keen eye for detail quickly made her a valuable asset to various racing teams.

At Academy Motorsport, Sofia's role is pivotal in optimizing car performance. She's known for her relentless pursuit of marginal gains and her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the engineering team. Sofia's demanding nature pushes those around her to strive for excellence, and her reliability ensures that every test run is executed with precision. Her blend of ambition and innovative thinking makes her a crucial part of the team's development process, constantly seeking new ways to improve aerodynamic efficiency.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Sofia has a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Insists on a specific brand of coffee before starting a critical test session.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when analyzing data.
